ui.stat.title: Statistics
ui.stat.intro: How many times the board restarted. Calendar periods, counted from the event log and shown in your computer’s time zone.
ui.acc.title: Tailscale account
ui.acc.down: Tailscale is not answering. The service may be stopped or starting: wait a few seconds and press “Refresh status”.
ui.acc.connected: The board is connected to the Tailscale network {tailnet} as {host}.
ui.acc.logout: Log out of the Tailscale account
ui.acc.off_confirm: Turn Tailscale off? Published routes stop working and the board cannot be reached remotely until you turn it on again from here (no new login is needed).
ui.acc.logout_confirm: Disconnect this board from the account? Published routes stop working and the board can no longer be reached remotely until you connect it again from here (a new link or key is needed).
ui.acc.stopped: The board is authenticated but Tailscale is stopped (turned off).
ui.acc.wait: The board asked for access and is waiting for approval in the Tailscale console (Admin → Machines). This page updates by itself.
ui.acc.not_connected: The board is not connected to a Tailscale account yet. Choose how to connect it: everything is done from here, no SSH needed.
ui.acc.mode_key: Log in with a key and tags
ui.acc.name: Board name (optional, lowercase only)
ui.acc.key_help: Create the key in Tailscale Admin → Settings → Keys. To use tags, the key must be created with the same tags and those tags must exist in the policy (tagOwners). The key is not stored on the board.
ui.acc.link_open: Open this link in a browser (a phone works too), sign in to your Tailscale account and approve the board. This page updates by itself.
ui.acc.connecting_key: Connecting: it can take up to a minute...
ui.acc.link_ready: Link ready: open it to complete the login.
ui.routes.title: Network configuration
ui.routes.intro: Configure the routes published on Tailscale. The Ethernet address configuration (DHCP or static IP) is handled in the dedicated section below.
ui.routes.subnets_help: At most 4 private subnets. In Selected devices mode only the single /32 IPs chosen below are published.
ui.routes.snat_help: Recommended: LAN devices see the Orange Pi’s IP
ui.routes.accept_help: Allows using subnets published by other nodes
ui.routes.dns_help: Applies the tailnet DNS settings to this Orange Pi
ui.routes.mismatch: Warning: the published network does not match the current LAN. Check before saving.
ui.routes.pick_one: Select at least one device from the LAN scan.
ui.routes.applied: Settings applied. Check the routes in the Tailscale admin panel.
ui.info.title: Status and information
ui.info.intro: Changing the routes does not interrupt the device’s Tailscale connection. In selected mode the LAN firewall blocks forwarding to the IPs that were not chosen.
ui.info.approve: After publishing a subnet, check the approval in Tailscale Admin → Machines. Without approval the network is not reachable.
ui.info.public_warning: This panel is not meant for the public Internet: do not open TCP port 8443 on the router.
ui.info.detected_set: Detected network entered: press Save configuration to apply it.
ui.lan.title: LAN Device Discovery
ui.lan.intro: ARP scanner of the local Ethernet network only: it detects IP, MAC, vendor and hostname when resolvable. Select the devices to publish as /32 routes. Scanning does not change the routes.
ui.lan.note: The selection is based on the IP: MAC and hostname only help to recognise the device. For NVR/RAPTOR use static IPs or DHCP reservations. /32 routes need Tailscale approval; for full access control you also need Grants/ACL rules.
ui.lan.not_seen: Not seen in the last scan
ui.eth.title: Ethernet network · DHCP / static IP
ui.eth.intro: Persistent configuration of end0. An IP change may briefly interrupt SSH and this page. You must reconnect and press Confirm configuration within 150 seconds, otherwise the previous configuration is restored automatically.
ui.eth.pending_text: Open the panel again at the new address and press the button below. If the browser cannot find the network, wait for the automatic restore.
ui.eth.note: Before setting a static IP, choose an address that is free and outside the DHCP pool of the customer’s router, to avoid conflicts. After the change Tailscale reconnects; publishing a different subnet must be updated and approved separately.
ui.eth.confirm_start: Change the Ethernet configuration now? The connection may drop. If you do not confirm within 150 seconds, an automatic restore is attempted.
ui.eth.scheduled: Change scheduled. Reconnect at the new address and press Confirm.
ui.sec.title: Security · Change password
ui.sec.intro: Change the Web UI login password. The current password is required. After the change all open sessions (also on other devices) are closed and you will have to log in again.
ui.sec.rules: At least 12 characters, with at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter and one number. Symbols are optional. A long, unique password is recommended.
ui.sec.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
ui.sec.weak: Use 12-128 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a number.
ui.sec.confirm: Do you confirm the password change? All sessions will be signed out.
ui.sec.done: Password updated. Please log in again.
ui.ev.title: Events · Restarts and system status
ui.ev.intro: Log kept on the board (even after a shutdown): boots, regular shutdowns and unclean shutdowns, that is power loss or a freeze. Times are those of your computer.
ui.ev.note: Without a battery the board starts with the clock behind until it synchronises with the Internet: until “Clock synchronised” appears, the times of the latest boot may be wrong. After a power loss, the last sign of life shows by when it happened (at most 5 minutes earlier).
ui.ev.detail.logged_late: recorded when the board was already running (installation)
ui.ev.summary: Running for {span} (since {date}) · Boots in the last 30 days: {boots} · Unclean shutdowns in the last 30 days: {unclean}{last}

ui.login.too_many: Too many attempts. Try again later.
